notes: Real removal has no hidden-background ground truth. Full source/output contact sheets inspected. Actual text prompts tested: dog and woman wearing a white skirt. Third run reuses prior masks.

runs.name: white-skirt-text

selection.policy: highest scoring first-frame candidate; inspect selection preview

runs.method: ORB + RANSAC homography; masked temporal median; Telea fallback; hard composite inside expanded mask
runs.notes: Prototype. First-frame highest-score text selection can be wrong. Non-target moving objects are not masked. Homographies assume approximately planar background/pure rotation. Observation support does not imply correctness. No claim of hidden-background accuracy on real removal.
